title: DREB Transcription Factors and Stress Tolerance in Plants
summary: This cluster focuses on the relationship between DREB transcription factors and their role in abiotic and biotic stress tolerance in plants. Agarwal, P. K. is associated with DREB transcription factors and contributes to stress tolerance in plants. Other researchers, including Ahmad, P., Reddy, M. K., Sarwat, M., Sharma, S., and Sopory, S., are also part of this cluster, suggesting a collaborative effort in understanding the mechanisms of stress tolerance in plants. The involvement of Plant Cell Reports, a scientific publication, implies that the research has been documented and shared with the scientific community.
